subject: Shiny App keeps reloading in the web browser

messages.author: ca166e227da5a1a6
messages.subject: Shiny App keeps reloading in the web browser
parts:
Hi,

I am facing a little weird issue. I started working on an existing shiny Application and did some work related to creating new tags and elements as per requirement. Now i wanted to do a setup on my local machine as well. I installed R with all the required packages (namely shiny, shinyFiles, shinythemes, oro.nifti). Now everytime i run the script to run the application, it opens up fine with all the I/Os and elements. However, it keeps on reloading (1.png) and i cannot access any of the Input elements. As soon as i select any of the input directory button, it opens the window to choose the directory but goes in background and I cannot access the same (2.png).

The attachments describe the same in visual manner.

Let me know if i can try few things since i relatively new to shiny and R and do not know where to start from. I do have a system on which the same application is working fine. So in case you want me to compare few things that possibility is open!

Thanks in advance,

Shubham
